messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: detected sustained packet loss on POP us-west1 egress to EdgeTransit (ASN 64500). Loss observed: 15-30% for multiple prefixes (203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24). Threshold breached for 3m. Pager: alice (oncall). Severity: P1.

alice (oncall): I'm on. Joining a quick bridge in 1m. tagging @ben - network and @carla - sre. Starting incident doc.

alice (oncall): quick check — telemetry shows spike in 5xx and TCP retransmits for us-west1 edge. Noticing customer errors from us-west region.

ben - network: looking now. Can you paste traceroute/mtr to one of the affected prefixes from the POP? Also calling EdgeTransit NOC.

alice (oncall): pasting mtr from the POP -> prefix 203.0.113.1:
```
Start: Tue Mar 10 20:15:12 2026
HOST: pop-us-west1.example.com
                 Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
 1. 10.0.0.1        0.0%   100    0.3   0.8   0.2   5.0   0.9
 2. 198.51.100.5   25.0%   100   10.2  12.4   9.8  48.1   6.5
 3. 203.0.113.1    23.0%   100   11.0  13.2  10.0  49.0   6.8
```

ben - network: yep that's consistent. Packet loss sits at the provider hop. Opening ticket with EdgeTransit (TICKET-3942). I'm prepping BGP mitigations: temporary withdraw or prepending to move traffic to us-west2.

edgeprovider-bot: EdgeTransit NOC: We see elevated loss on our egress to your POP, correlating with high scrubber load. We're applying targeted filters; ETA 10-20m to see improvement. (I will update ticket TICKET-3942).

carla - sre: runbook step: set incident status to "degraded (regional)" on status.redwood.ai and push note to customers. Dave, can you draft a short customer-facing blurb re: increased errors for US-west users?

alice (oncall): mitigation path A: request provider to filter (in progress). Path B (immediate): steer user-facing traffic away from us-west1 to us-west2 by manipulating BGP local preferences/communities on our edge and add temporary prepends towards EdgeTransit. Will perform Path B now as a short-lived emergency failover.

ben - network: I'll run the BGP change now. Preparing commands. Expect ~60s to see delta because caches.

ben - network: applied prepends + set community 64500:65432 (prefer-us-west2). Monitoring.

erin - telemetry: after prepends applied: packet loss on probe to 203.0.113.1 dropped from 23% -> 2.1% within 90s. 5xx rate across affected routes down ~78%. Captured timeline and metrics.

alice (oncall): :white_check_mark: Good. Rolling mitigation held traffic on us-west2. Notifying oncall+customers.

dave - customer success: Draft for status page and customer pings:
"We are investigating increased errors and timeouts for customers in the US West region (approx 20-30% of requests) due to a third-party network provider egress issue. Traffic has been temporarily rerouted to an alternate POP; customers should see improvements. We will provide updates as we have them."

carla - sre: publish that with ETA for next update 30m. Adding incident tag and linking this Slack thread.

edgeprovider-bot: EdgeTransit NOC: filters in place; seeing gradual recovery in scrubber metrics. We still have elevated retransmits in one of the transit clusters. Keeping ticket open.

alice (oncall): Plan: keep emergency prepends in place until provider confirms stable for 1h with low loss. Post-incident: require provider postmortem and confirm why their scrubber impacted our egress instead of absorbing traffic. Action items created.

ben - network: created playbook PR to automate community-based failover for this scenario (will include canary thresholds and automated prepend once 3m loss>10%). Linking PR after handoff.

erin - telemetry: snapshot metrics at mitigation start/end attached to incident doc (percentiles, affected routes, customer impact). Will add alert thresholds to detect if similar pattern repeats across multiple POPs.

carla - sre: preparing a short RCA skeleton: timeline, root cause (EdgeTransit scrubber overload causing egress packet loss), mitigations taken (BGP steer to us-west2, provider filtering), impact (US-west user errors + elevated latencies), follow-ups (provider postmortem, automated reroute runbook, status page wording update).

alice (oncall): handing off to night oncall (ben) at 23:30 UTC. Handoff notes: mitigation active, prepends in place, EdgeTransit ticket TICKET-3942 open, status page published, customers notified. If loss increases >5% for 5m, remove prepends and re-evaluate or contact provider NOC immediately.

ben - network: acknowledged handoff. Will keep monitoring and will escalate to partner mgmt if provider doesn't provide written postmortem in 48h.

carla - sre: closing channel for P1 but keeping incident doc open for follow-ups. Final note: generate post-incident communication once provider PM delivers findings. :memo:
